cohort.title: 2020년 한국을 빛낼 100인
selection_process: 편집국 취재기자 약 200명의 도움으로 추천위원 205명 선정
1단계: 추천위원이 분야 무관 3명씩 추천하여 355명 후보군 생성
99명 편집부 선정 후 100번째 인물은 독자 추천 824건에서 자문위원 검토로 백경학 선정
cohort.why_methodologically_valuable: 선정 시점에 목표연도 2020을 명시하여 actual target-year calibration이 가능

analysis_eligible_if: primary_donga_2010: 2010 Donga series directly names/quotes person as one of selected 100
official_institution_2010: contemporaneous institution explicitly states Donga selection
retrospective_guarantees_2010: later Donga/official record explicitly establishes consecutive selections covering 2010
not_analysis_eligible_if: biographical secondary claim without original/official corroboration
category inferred only without membership confirmation
evidence_policy.reason_for_revision: v0.1 treated a secondary copied 20-person creator list as complete, but Son Yeol-eum is independently documented as selected three consecutive years beginning with the 2010 series and was absent from that copied list. Therefore completeness claims from the secondary copy are invalidated.

reconstruction.category_completeness_status: NONE CLAIMED COMPLETE in v0.2; even if a category count reaches its target, exact membership must be reconciled against primary/official evidence before declaring completeness.

next_steps: Continue primary-source reconstruction until exact 100 names are reconciled.
Do not calculate 2020 target-year precision on the current partial/cleaned set.
Resolve category for analysis-eligible members with category unknown.
Recover remaining Hall-of-Fame names from 2012 image/text and use only if 2010 membership is explicitly guaranteed.
Once exact 100 is complete, freeze T0 roster before any target-year outcome coding.
